kurals.tr: Anputaimai Aandra Kutippiraththal Vendhavaam / Panputaimai Thoodhuraippaan Panpu
kurals.m: The qualification of an ambassador are affection (for his relations) a fitting birth, and the possession of attributes pleasing to royalty

kurals.tr: Anparivu Aaraaindha Solvanmai Thoodhuraippaarkku / Indri Yamaiyaadha Moondru
kurals.m: Love (to his sovereign), knowledge (of his affairs), and a discriminating power of speech (before other sovereigns) are the three sine qua non qualifications of an ambassador

kurals.tr: Noolaarul Noolvallan Aakudhal Velaarul / Vendri Vinaiyuraippaan Panpu
kurals.m: To be powerful in politics among those who are learned (in ethics) is the character of him who speaks

kurals.tr: Arivuru Vaaraaindha Kalviim Moondran / Serivutaiyaan Selka Vinaikku
kurals.m: He may go on a mission (to foreign rulers) who has combined in him all these three viz, (natural) sense, an attractive bearing and well-tried learning

kurals.tr: Thokach Chollith Thoovaadha Neekki / Nakachcholli Nandri Payappadhaan Thoodhu
kurals.m: He is an ambassador who (in the presence of foreign rulers) speaks briefly, avoids harshness, talks so as to make them smile, and thus brings good (to his own sovereign)

kurals.tr: Katrukkan Anjaan Selachchollik Kaalaththaal / Thakkadhu Arivadhaam Thoodhu
kurals.m: He is an ambassador who having studied (politics) talks impressively, is not afraid of angry looks, and knows (to employ) the art suited to the time

kurals.tr: Katanarindhu Kaalang Karudhi Itanarindhu / Enni Uraippaan Thalai
kurals.m: He is chief (among ambassadors) who understands the proper decorum (before foreign princes), seeks the (proper) occasion, knows the (most suitable) place, and delivers his message after (due)

kurals.tr: Thooimai Thunaimai Thunivutaimai Immoondrin / Vaaimai Vazhiyuraippaan Panpu
kurals.m: The qualifications of him who faithfully delivers his (sovereign's) message are purity, the support (of foreign ministers), and boldness, with truthfulness in addition to the (aforesaid) three

kurals.tr: Vitumaatram Vendharkku Uraippaan Vatumaatram / Vaaiseraa Vanka Navan
kurals.m: He alone is fit to communicate (his sovereign's) reply, who possesses the firmness not to utter even inadvertently what may reflect discredit (on the latter)

kurals.tr: Irudhi Payappinum Enjaadhu Iraivarku / Urudhi Payappadhaam Thoodhu
kurals.m: He is the ambassador who fearlessly seeks his sovereign's good though it should cost him his life (to deliver his message)
